title: 'KPop Demon Hunters': For The Fans! Destination Is Now on Netflix
summary: Alongside the Netflix film, sing-along version and bonus content, the collection includes: all-new choreography videos featuring new HUNTR/X animation and popular dance creators, and custom stop-motion animation videos.
body_markdown:
###


An All-New "Golden" Home for the Fandom


Starting today, fans can explore even more


KPop Demon Hunters


on


[Netflix](http://netflix.com/kpopdemonhuntersforthefans) – all in one place. Introducing


KPop Demon Hunters: For the Fans!


,


a first-of-its-kind, all-new destination on Netflix bringing together the ultimate collection of


KPop Demon Hunters


content that celebrates the music and characters fans love while discovering original and playful creations. Alongside the award-winning film, fan-favorite sing-along version and bonus content, some of the new content in the collection includes: all-new official choreography videos featuring new HUNTR/X animation and popular dance creators, and custom stop-motion animation videos showcasing HUNTR/X in a new style.


WHAT’S ON THE HUB


-


NEW! PLAYlist Stories:


-


HUNTR/X Backstage Pass:


In this visually kinetic and fun stop-motion narrative 6-episode series, fans get exclusive access to HUNTR/X behind the scenes: rehearsals, photoshoots, costume fittings, and more.


-


KPop Toy Creations:


A 3-episode series of hand-made mini episodes inspired by


KPop Demon Hunters


and produced by one young filmmaking visionary, all between homework and dinner time.


-


Play Games With Us:


A 4-episode stop-motion animation series that's full of colorful competitions, challenges and fun, inspired by iconic scenes in


KPop Demon Hunters


.


-


NEW! Learn the Choreo!:


-


Fans can now dance like HUNTR/X and Saja Boys with a slate of official choreography content that turns the film’s biggest musical moments into something fans can learn and perform.


-


Watch HUNTR/X rehearsing “How It’s Done.”


-


Learn the complete routines straight from the choreographers behind the film, covering: “How It’s Done,” “Golden,” “Takedown,” “Soda Pop,” and “Your Idol.”


-


Choose your bias. Three Hunters. Three signature styles. Choreographers Nain and Leejung Lee break down how Rumi, Mira, and Zoey’s personalities shape the way they move.


-


Watch the Movie:


-


The award-winning film that’s spent 67 weeks on Netflix’s Global Top 10 list.


-


Happy Honmoon! More for the fans:


-


Lyric Videos for 7 songs from the film


-


Sing-Along version of the film


-


Fan Collection (4 videos featuring fan-created content, plus HUNTR/X voice talent reacting


-


KPop Demon Hunters


themed fireplace


---


ABOUT


KPOP DEMON HUNTERS


:


KPop Demon Hunters


, directed by Maggie Kang and Chris Appelhans, became a global phenomenon shortly following its release on June 20, 2025. The film is Netflix's most popular film of all time, surpassing over 670 million views with 63 consecutive weeks on Netflix's Global Top 10.


It swept every award category: winning Best Animated Feature at the Academy Awards, Critics' Choice Awards, Golden Globes, as well as ten Annie Awards. Its breakout song "Golden" became the first K-pop track to win both an Oscar and a Grammy.


The soundtrack continues to make history as the first to place four songs simultaneously in the Billboard Hot 100 top ten, accumulating over 15 billion global streams. "Golden" held No. 1 on the Hot 100 for eight weeks — the longest such run by a female group this century — and was certified 5x Platinum.
